name: Immobiliere Dassault SA
summary: Immobiliere Dassault SA is a real estate investment firm specializing in Core and Value Add strategies. The firm primarily invests in office and retail properties. It targets real estate assets located in Paris and its first ring (Première Couronne), France. The firm requires its total bank debt to remain under 50% of its total asset value. For its acquisitions, it targets deal sizes between EUR 5 million and EUR 20 million with debt leverage of 50% to 100% of the investment value. The firm prefers a long-term asset management approach focused on yield and dividend distributions, and operates under the French listed real estate investment trust (SIIC) tax regime.
